Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Close the two required release-convergence gaps by restoring truthful weapon/build choices and spatially readable authored-arena traversal, while repairing the coupled automatic-attack audio causality defect and preserving both Godot boot baselines.

diagnosis.root_cause: The release candidate has an unbound upgrade-card presentation path that emits placeholder CURRENT values, an authored-arena integration/framing path that hides the central landmark and reduces traversal readability, and an automatic-combat feedback path missing a distinct lantern impact cue.

stop_conditions: Stop after both bounded implementation tasks are complete and direct black-box plus white-box retest evidence is available for Tester.
Do not expand into deferred dense-profile qualification or unrelated backlog gaps.

strategy.rationale: Use authoritative state binding and transaction repair for the HUD/combat family, and a materially different authored-world restoration/rebinding strategy for the arena family instead of repeating camera-only transform tuning.

code: Run the native Godot project and host boot checks after import; confirm no parser or runtime errors in touched scripts/scenes.

White-box verify upgrade values resolve from authoritative build/weapon data, audio stems have single event ownership, and authored-world bounds, collision, navigation, spawn/objective anchors, and camera framing share the same transform space.
Preserve passing native_godot_project and host_godot_boot validation requirements.
runtime: Tester opens the level-up draft at shipped resolution, exercises keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, selects once, and verifies authoritative build mutation, resumed clocks, and XP overflow.
Tester captures one automatic lantern attack authorization and its impact, checking exactly one bounded attack transient, distinct impact onset, and clean pause/retry/reset audio lifecycle.
Tester performs movement replay from spawn through the critical route and central building/landmark to the boundary/perimeter, checking player/enemy/boss collision and stable visibility.
Tester reruns release_convergence_weapon_build_identity_contract and release_convergence_wave_director_boss_contract; dense-profile native qualification remains deferred.
visual: Upgrade cards replace text-stacked presentation with silhouettes/icons, restrained copy, truthful compact current-to-new deltas, and visible keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states with no em-dash CURRENT placeholders.

Sparse shipped-camera views cover spawn, critical route, central building/landmark near contact and after departure, and perimeter; confirm external world/depth, readable player/boss, aligned collision, and no disappearance or occlusion.

done_when: Text-stacked upgrade/weapon choices are replaced by authored silhouettes or icons with a clear visual hierarchy.
Every displayed NEW weapon/upgrade card has a truthful non-placeholder CURRENT value sourced from authoritative weapon/build state.
Each choice presents no more than three decision-relevant current-to-new stat deltas; unchanged, locked, and unrelated rows are omitted.
Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, hover, unavailable, and selected states are visibly distinct without changing card dimensions.
Opening one level-up draft pauses gameplay once; held confirm cannot select twice; selecting a card applies the authoritative build change before gameplay resumes and preserves experience overflow.

A bounded automatic lantern attack test produces exactly one recognizable attack transient per authorization, with a short distinct lantern-impact cue that cannot mask or be mistaken for the attack; release, pause, retry, and reset leave no lingering or duplicated audio.
Tester can retest the draft selection and audio causality directly in the same loop, while white-box inspection traces card values and audio ownership to authoritative runtime systems.
tasks.instructions: Repair the weapon/build choice and automatic-combat feedback family. Replace text-stacked upgrade and weapon choices with authored silhouettes/icons, compact stat icons, and an explicit visual hierarchy. Bind upgrade-draft CURRENT values to authoritative run/build and weapon-definition data, then render concise truthful current-to-new values with no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas and complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus behavior. Preserve the level-up transaction boundary, held-confirm debounce, eligibility rules, overflow XP, and observable post-selection weapon change. Isolate the lantern attack authorization, attack transient, and lantern impact stems so each automatic attack has one bounded recognizable report and impact onset is short, distinct, and lifecycle-safe. Keep the existing native project and preserved source assets intact; provide direct black-box and white-box retest paths for Tester.
tasks.title: Replace text-stacked choices with truthful visual hierarchy and distinct attack feedback

done_when: The authored arena is restored or rebound at a larger traversable scale, with coherent external world and external depth beyond the playable boundary/perimeter.

The central building/landmark remains visible and readable from spawn, the critical route, near contact, after departure, and cardinal views during ordinary movement/movement replay; it never disappears through camera occlusion.

Native authored streets/terrain remain the authoritative walkable surface; visible geometry and collision align, and the player, ordinary enemies, and boss cannot pass through the landmark or boundary/perimeter.

Spawn, objective anchors, navigation, camera framing, and collision are rebased consistently to the authored world, with no void or proxy-floor takeover and no spawn inside collision or the protected camera area.
Active pressure and boss-phase transitions remain playable with readable boss health, telegraphs, and recovery windows after the spatial repair.

Tester can traverse from spawn to the central landmark and perimeter in a same-loop movement replay, while white-box bounds/spatial inspection verifies visibility, collision, navigation, and boundary behavior.
tasks.instructions: Repair arena spatial integrity through authored-world instance restoration/rebinding rather than another camera-only transform tweak. Keep the complete authored cemetery package intact, rebase camera/framing, spawn, objective, navigation, collision, and perimeter anchors onto its native streets/terrain, and expand the larger traversable scale with coherent external world/external depth. Ensure the central building/landmark stays visible during ordinary movement and movement replay from all relevant sides, with aligned collision and no disappearance or occlusion drift. Preserve wave-director and boss lifecycle behavior, including readable pressure and boss telegraph/health states. Avoid proxy roads/floors, duplicated landmark packs, or destructive asset surgery; expose focused spatial evidence checkpoints for Tester.
tasks.title: Restore authored arena scale, landmark visibility, and collision
